capabilities: Render notes as paginated, Homebrewery-style documents with a live preview
Compile multiple notes or folders into one paginated document via a {{bookContent}} block
Generate a table of contents with page numbers from note headings
Export notes as PDF with themes, backgrounds, and fonts preserved
Export self-contained HTML that opens without Obsidian or BrewVault
disambiguation: Not a publishing tool for hosting homebrew online; it renders and exports local notes to PDF and HTML.
extras: Manual installation from a release package is described in the README. Mobile releases are tested on Android only; mobile PDF export can either hand off to an installed browser (selectable text) or write an image-based PDF directly in Obsidian. Project is MIT-licensed and unaffiliated with NaturalCrit or Wizards of the Coast.
intentEvidence: Compact Homebrewery tag labels in the Markdown editor for a seamless workflow transition.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render or export notes as paginated, Homebrewery-style tabletop RPG documents; authors had to leave the app to use Homebrewery.

relations.evidence: inspired by and adapts theme resources from the open-source Homebrewery project
The project scaffold is adapted from the official, 0BSD-licensed Obsidian sample plugin.

summary: Renders Markdown notes into themed, paginated D&D 5e documents with live preview, PDF export, and self-contained HTML export.
